title: Robust Quantum Algorithmic Binary Decision-Making on Gaussian Signals
summary: A relevant signal in the quantum domain may manifest as a displacement or a squeezing operator in the bosonic phase space. For a real parameter $β$ embedded in such a Gaussian operator, the task of determining if $β\in [β_{-th}, β_{+th}]$ for real asymmetric thresholds $(β_{-th} \ne -β_{+th})$ is a binary decision problem. We propose a framework, the \emph{generalized quantum signal processing interferometry} (GQSPI), to solve this parameter detection problem by recasting the practical task of active binary hypothesis testing on quantum systems to a polynomial approximation problem.
